verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents Codex running tasks in 'isolated cloud environments' with configurable setup, suggesting sandboxed execution (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-4), but community reports raise doubts about actual sandbox integrity, including a user asking if Codex 'still read[s] sensitive data on your file system without even asking' (linking a GitHub issue) and another expressing being 'paranoid about keeping things securely sandboxed.'
